title: BTS Members Freeze in Shock When Drake Drops Their Name in a New Song!
summary: Picture this: you're chilling with your friend, listening to a new song by one of the biggest rappers in the world. Suddenly, he mentions YOUR group! That's exactly what happened to BTS members V and J-Hope. Drake just dropped his new album Iceman, and on the first track, he raps: "I'm feeling like BTS 'cause it took the whole career for me to be so discovered." V posted a video on Instagram showing their live reaction. The two are nodding along to the beat, looking cool in their hats. But the second they hear "BTS," they freeze. They stare at each other with their mouths open, totally shocked. It's the kind of moment that makes you laugh and say, "Did that really just happen?!" This isn't the first time Drake and BTS have crossed paths. Back in 2018, Drake put J-Hope's dance to his song "In My Feelings" in his official music video. And in a 2019 interview, J-Hope said Drake was his dream collaborator. RM even joked, "Drake, please call our label if you have time." Now, with this surprise shoutout, fans are wondering: could a collab finally happen? BTS just released their own album Arirang and are about to start a huge world tour. Drake dropped three albums in one day—yes, three! The internet is buzzing, and V and J-Hope's priceless reaction is just the cherry on top.
why_it_matters: It shows that even world-famous celebrities can get starstruck, and a friendly mention can bring fans together and spark new collaborations.
